dialogues.speaker: Izad
dialogues.text: I heard from some students passing by that some ores appeared in a place nearby. They were so absorbed in discussing a problem that they didn't watch where they were going and tripped over some Magical Crystal Ores.

dialogues.speaker: Izad
dialogues.text: I could help clean them up if I had my tools with me... I can tell you the location if you want to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Izad
dialogues.text: Ores are pretty useful. You need them too, right?
